description: Enhanced per-message consume coverage: two independent per-message deliveries in one scenario each create their own root-trace consumer span (distinct trace labels), and a synchronous non-promise handler on a different topic still yields one well-formed process span.

cases.expected_output:
consume_message topic=topic-name-1 delivered=ok error=none
consume_message topic=topic-name-2 delivered=ok error=none
spans=2
span 0 kind=consumer name=topic-name-1 trace=t0 parent=root status=unset
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=topic-name-1
  messaging.destination_kind=topic
  messaging.operation=process
span 1 kind=consumer name=topic-name-2 trace=t1 parent=root status=unset
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=topic-name-2
  messaging.destination_kind=topic
  messaging.operation=process

consume_message topic=orders delivered=ok error=none
spans=1
span 0 kind=consumer name=orders trace=t0 parent=root status=unset
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=orders
  messaging.destination_kind=topic
  messaging.operation=process
